findings.description: AC-1 requires every main and test class of every module to be in package com.snoworca.naruserve or a subpackage of it. Frozen D-403 (wave 4) requires the Logcat Logger JVM test to run against a test-scope fake android.util.Log class, so this AC cannot hold. D-008 fixes the package root used by modules. It does not ban test classes outside that root.
findings.suggested_action: Limit AC-1 to main source set classes, or exempt test-scope stand-ins for platform classes such as the D-403 android.util.Log fake.

findings.description: AC-1 says the Logcat Logger module 'contains no compile-time reference to an android.* type', which covers its test sources too. D-403 requires a test-scope fake android.util.Log in that module, and its tests reference it. D-385 is only about the module's compile-time Android dependency.
findings.suggested_action: Say 'its main source set contains no compile-time reference to an android.* type', and allow a test-scope android.util.Log fake (D-403).

findings.description: AC-1 allows kotlin-stdlib in other modules 'at most on test configurations'. Every module that applies KGP (needed for the Kotlin smoke and T11 tests in Java modules) gets the plugin-owned configurations kotlinCompilerClasspath and kotlinBuildToolsApiClasspath, and these resolve kotlin-stdlib. Read literally, AC-1 fails for those modules even though nothing leaks.
findings.suggested_action: Name the configurations checked: kotlin-stdlib is absent from api, implementation, compileOnly, runtimeOnly, compileClasspath and runtimeClasspath of every module other than the Kotlin extension module.

findings.description: D-108 (wave 2) puts the in-memory HttpAdapter in a test fixtures source set of NaruServe-api. That needs the java-test-fixtures plugin and testFixtures* configurations. D-005 says later waves add only test-scope dependencies or the #18 release plugins, and the CON-BUILD-006 run-end note checks against the wave-1 graph. If wave 1 does not set this up, the later wave breaks the D-005 check.
findings.suggested_action: Add an Implementation Note: wave 1 applies java-test-fixtures to NaruServe-api (or the run-end D-005 check treats testFixtures setup as test scope). Keep its scope decision with the implementer (C-07).

findings.description: AC-3 makes sourceCompatibility/targetCompatibility 1.8 mandatory. No design item asks for this. It is one way to pass the KGP JVM-target consistency check, and other valid ways (for example kotlin.jvm.target.validation.mode) would fail this AC. The [D-006, D-007] tags overstate the trace.
findings.suggested_action: Change AC-3 to an outcome ('KGP JVM-target validation passes on JDK 17 with no inconsistent-target error'), and move the compatibility settings to an Implementation Note.

findings.description: AC-1 'Every Java module' does not say which of the nine modules count. NaruServe-kotlin is a Kotlin-source module. D-022 has the same wording, but the AC could name the set.
findings.suggested_action: List the modules, or say 'every module with Java test sources'.

findings.description: CON-BUILD-013 is Stability=draft, but its heading lacks the [DRAFT — pending decision] marker that SRS-MD §30.2 requires. The iter-1 title edit appears to have dropped it. The other 15 headings carry it.
findings.suggested_action: Reapply the marker through an MCP mutation (for example a no-op update_stability to draft or a title edit that restores it). Do not hand-edit.
